In this video, we take you on one of the most breathtaking road trips in the Indian Himalayas—Adi Kailash and Om Parvat in the Kumaon region of Uttarakhand.
Our journey begins from Dharchula, a beautiful border town in Pithoragarh district, located approximately 92 km from Pithoragarh and around 170 km from Munsiyari.
We stayed at Manas Tourist Rest House (KMVN), Dharchula, which overlooks the magnificent Kali River. This river forms the India–Nepal border. On the Indian side it is called the Kali River, while across the border in Nepal it is known as the Mahakali River.
